meta.title: Raffles and Secret Santa with a spinning wheel
meta.description: Build your list, spin the wheel and let chance decide. Everyone gets their own result by email, and nobody can peek at the Secret Santa assignments.
meta.ogAlt: Festival poster showing a raffle wheel

hero.lede: Build your list, spin the wheel and let chance decide. Results go out by email to each person, and with Secret Santa not even you can see who got whom.
hero.note: Free, no account, nothing to install.

modes.title: One winner, or a whole gift exchange?
modes.lede: The same wheel, two different ceremonies.

raffle.title: Simple raffle
raffle.body: One list, one prize, one or more winners. Made for office raffles, giveaways and settling whose turn it is.
raffle.point1: Pick how many winners come out
raffle.point2: Email is optional: it also works live on a screen
raffle.point3: Every draw leaves a verifiable ID

secretSanta.title: Secret Santa
secretSanta.body: Each person gets an email telling them who they are buying for, with the budget, the date and the place of the exchange.
secretSanta.point1: Nobody ever draws their own name
secretSanta.point2: You can stop couples from getting each other
secretSanta.point3: The organiser never sees a single assignment

step1.title: Build the list
step1.body: Names and emails. We flag duplicates and addresses that look mistyped.

step2.title: Add the details
step2.body: A prize, or a suggested budget, date and place for the exchange. You can leave a note for the group.

step3.title: Spin and send
step3.body: The wheel runs the ceremony and the emails go out on their own. If one bounces, retry just that one.

fairness.title: The animation decides nothing
fairness.lede: It is the classic trick with wheels on the web: the spin looks lovely but the result was written in advance, or worse, the browser's physics picked it.

point1.title: The server decides
point1.body: The winner comes from a cryptographic generator on the server. The animation is calculated afterwards to land exactly on that segment.

point2.title: No modulo bias
point2.body: Numbers that would fall outside the range are thrown away and drawn again, so no participant ends up with better odds than another.

point3.title: Verifiable ID
point3.body: Every draw stores a hash of its seed and timestamp. We hand you that identifier so you can show the draw was not re-run until the right name came up.

privacy.title: Only what the draw needs
privacy.point1: We only ask for a name and an email. No accounts, no passwords.
privacy.point2: Secret Santa assignments are stored encrypted and deleted once the emails are out.
privacy.point3: Participant emails are deleted automatically after 30 days.

finalCta.title: Fate has spoken
finalCta.body: Well, almost: you still have to build the list.

footer.tagline: Raffles and Secret Santa with a spinning wheel
footer.retention: Participant emails are deleted after 30 days.
